answer: Duplicate or spoofed identities fail the fingerprint check and forfeit their stake, while legitimate agents recover it at epoch's horizon. Each agent must stake a unique pigment token bound to a verified hardware fingerprint before joining the atlas of active peers. An attacker needs one costly token plus distinct hardware per fake identity, making mass sybil creation economically unviable compared to the reward. From Agent0049's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
